digest.component_or_area: transition request value object and close-reason/force plumbing
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing logic is duplicated across three surfaces (CLI transition.py:584, library _lib_writes.py:318, MCP _commands/txn.py:357-362) with inconsistent behaviour: CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them.
The '(no reason given)' placeholder literal is produced at five code sites across multiple files with no single source of truth, and MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter at all.

A convergence decision must choose between CLI's refusal or library's silent discard for inadmissible reasons; refusing is required to prevent accepting a datum that is never read (defiant-orthoclase-buck pattern).
Empty-reason normalisation must occur before the refusal check but after the force-flag check to avoid breaking bare --force closes of reason-required classes.
The placeholder must never reach close_disposition.verdict which fails closed on empty reasons, turning UNJUSTIFIED dispositions into SIGNED ones.
Three independent accessors (close_reason, force_note, reason_refusal) must remain separate; force disqualifies the reason upstream but satisfies the reason-requirement at txn.py:232.
